paper_ready_claim: This study addresses nine-class failure-pattern classification on WM-811K wafer bin maps.
evidence_source: 00_项目管理/20260729_最终模型冻结清单.json
interpretation_limit: Classification only; not AOI object detection.

paper_ready_claim: The selected model is HighRes ShuffleNetV2 trained with CrossEntropyLoss and without ECA.
evidence_source: 00_项目管理/20260729_最终模型冻结清单.json
interpretation_limit: Do not describe ECA or Focal Loss as final components.

paper_ready_claim: The no-ECA variant was selected because its three-seed mean validation Macro-F1 was slightly higher than the ECA variant.
interpretation_limit: Selection evidence, not a general proof that ECA is harmful.

paper_ready_claim: Across three random seeds, the final model achieved 98.0342% +/- 0.0039% accuracy and 90.2029% +/- 0.1965% Macro-F1.
key_value: mean +/- sample SD across seeds 42, 123, and 2026

paper_ready_claim: Relative to the saved ResNet18 baseline, the final model improved mean accuracy by 0.1657 percentage points and mean Macro-F1 by 1.3787 percentage points.
key_value: one baseline run vs three final-model runs
interpretation_limit: Conditional on saved models; baseline training-seed uncertainty is unavailable.

paper_ready_claim: All three paired accuracy and Macro-F1 comparisons remained significant after Holm correction at alpha=0.05.
interpretation_limit: Sample-level inference conditional on fixed trained models.

paper_ready_claim: The final model reduced parameter count by 88.70% relative to ResNet18.
The serialized state-dict tensor footprint was reduced by 88.57%.
interpretation_limit: State-dict tensor footprint, not a complete deployed application size.

paper_ready_claim: Do not claim that the final model is computationally faster than ResNet18.
interpretation_limit: The final model was slower on the measured Apple M1 Pro MPS setup.

paper_ready_claim: The main persistent weaknesses involved Loc, Scratch, and Edge-Loc patterns, often confused with none.
key_value: 381 samples wrong in all three seeds; 359 with the same wrong class
interpretation_limit: Post-test descriptive analysis; no subsequent model tuning.

paper_ready_claim: Do not claim external-dataset or factory-line generalization.
